title: The Ropewalk
reference: F2 F2 def F1 { tally_up repeat tally { forward } jump } def F2 { F1 turn_left F1 turn_right }
hints: Up the rope stacks: 1, 2, 3, 4, each ending with a jump, turning left, then right.
F1 counts, walks and jumps. F2 calls F1, turns left, calls F1, turns right.

story.intro: PATCH: "The top of the Ropewalk. Two routines, one tally, and a climb at the end of every stretch."
